text: ChatGPT PR #28 (Phase 17 event bus) reviewed line-by-line: RATIFIED with three repairs. subject: review:pr29
text: ChatGPT PR #29 (repo-only systems foundation: stateio/scheduler/outcomes/contacts/calendar/communications/context/devices/gaps/proactive/projects/recovery) reviewed line-by-line: RATIFIED as written. Uniformly fail-closed validation, private-by-default storage, idempotent occurrence claims, hash-bound plans, ambiguity always refused rather than guessed. subject: review:pr30
text: ChatGPT PR #30 (integration/autonomy layer) reviewed line-by-line: RATIFIED WITH REPAIRS — the same honesty disease Phase 7 review caught, three ways. (1) automation.execute's registry note claimed 'Core wiring is in this draft'; PR30 does not touch core.py — the wiring was built this session instead. (2) policy.delegate was marked AVAILABLE while NO acting path consumes grants; downgraded to EXPERIMENTAL — wiring consumption would widen authority and waits on an explicit operator ruling. (3) The registry rewrite thinned caller/notes/verification prose on all 31 pre-existing entries and inflated calendar.read/room.scene from NOT_BUILT to NEEDS_CONFIGURATION with no adapter to configure; main's prose restored, statuses reverted, rev 12. The authority module itself is well-designed (zero defaults, high-risk never delegable, exclusive claims).

subject: sprint
text: Sprint 2026-08-26e, ChatGPT PRs #28-30 integrated on claude/chatgpt-review-integration after line-by-line review. Built to close the review gaps: runtime.tick wired into every core_tick (due schedules execute through the intercom gates exactly once — proven live on the operator's PC: /api/runtime schedules:1, journal receipt); process_new_events turns watcher triggers + proactive proposals into notifications (event cursor, dedupe keys); Core API +6 endpoints (/api/state, /api/notifications+ack, /api/events, /api/watchers, /api/schedules, /api/runtime); Command Center notifications panel; python -m aletheia.assistant — 25 verb groups giving every personal-OS capability its real caller. Two Windows faults found by running here: supervisor install resolved the wrong pythonw from PATH (3.9, invisible refusal at logon) and the Core's git push popped a credential-manager GUI that hung the sync loop forever (git is now non-interactive, fails fast). Registry rev 12, 66 capabilities. 370 tests, 0 skipped, all green on this machine.
